text.k02: [warmly] Breakfast time~. Come on, come here.
text.k03: [softly] Nice and warm, huh, Nao-chan? Sunbathing?
text.k04: [softly] Oh, the sun moved away, didn't it.
text.k05: [laughs] Ah, no no~. It's cold, isn't it?
text.k06a: [chuckles softly] Hehe, there's nothing in there for you. Closing it~.
text.k07: [sighs softly] There we go. …Let me grab the hangers.
text.k08: [curious] Huh? Naomi? Where did you go?
text.k10: [laughs softly] Honestly, you always know where the warm spot is.
text.k12a: [chuckles softly] Hehe, you're kneading. That tickles.
text.k12b: [softly] …Going to sleep already? [whispers] Then me too.
